statement: Recognized source-form witnesses carry a well-defined source obstruction payload.
The refined lift produces a well-defined target payload object for recognized sources.
Source and target payloads satisfy the equality/refinement relation needed for preservation.
Canonicalizing source and target rows does not change payload meaning.
The lifted target payload preserves source obstruction meaning.
Counterexample status is preserved by the lifted payload.
If status is not preserved, the construction yields a smaller witness.
A validly lifted target payload is absorbed by the bounded family-chain theorem.
Self verification confirms consistency of valid lifted target objects.
Preservation failure is routed to named higher-support or payload-preservation blocker.
All preservation failure cases are represented in payload semantics/status semantics/phase2/escape inventories.
